WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. This project characterised burstiness by the Fano
factor of event counts and drew a conclusion about queueing theory from it.
Kingman's heavy-traffic approximation consumes the squared coefficient of
variation of interarrival times instead, and the two diverge sharply for a
self-exciting process. Holding the branching ratio at 0.8 fixes Fano and
sweeping the decay rate moves cv squared, so the two predictors are
separable by measurement. See docs/defects.md D8. Verdicts are not recorded
in this file: the analysis runs after the data is committed.
